ABZ Innovation opens a larger European drone factory

The new Szentendre facility in Hungary expands manufacturing for agricultural spraying, industrial cleaning and transport drones.

DroneDJ ↗18 September 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A new manufacturing base in Hungary

ABZ Innovation opened a facility in Szentendre around four times the size of its previous factory. The company aims to triple output in 2026 and double it again in 2027 as it responds to commercial drone demand.

Four product families

The range comprises L-Series spraying drones, S-Series seed and granular-material spreaders, C-Series high-pressure cleaning drones and M-Series multipurpose transport drones. The company reports deployments in more than 40 countries across six continents.

Production and after-sales support

The facility is intended to serve as a global manufacturing hub. ABZ emphasises European production, data control, training, spare parts and after-sales service for customers who use drones in their day-to-day operations.

The expansion behind the announcement

The investment follows a €7 million funding round in January 2026. ABZ says industrial cleaning is its fastest-growing product line. Its production targets remain plans whose eventual delivery will need to be assessed.
